claims.claim_text: Backlog grew from $1,067.0M (Dec 31, 2024) to $1,847.3M (Dec 31, 2025), an increase of $780.3M; the company specifically attributes the increase to 'continued bookings during the period, which includes the SDA Tranche 3 contract signed in December 2025, and the acquisition of GEOST.' Space Systems backlog stands at $1,371.7M of the total. The SDA Tranche 3 award is therefore a load-bearing pillar of forward Space Systems revenue.

claims.claim_text: 'In February 2022, the Company entered into a procurement agreement with MDA Corporation to design and manufacture of 17 spacecraft buses (the MDA Contract). The Company has determined that the projected delivery dates for certain deliverables will be later than the dates originally set out under the MDA Contract... the customer is potentially entitled to claim liquidated damages.' MDA Corporation here refers to MDA Ltd. (Canadian space prime, Globalstar-2/Telesat customer) — NOT the U.S. Missile Defense Agency. This is therefore a commercial spacecraft-bus delivery exposure, not a Pentagon program claim, but is checked to ensure it is not mis-mapped to MDA the agency.
